as_told.title: Lazar says he was inside an alien craft

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4 in 1988 and 1989, says he got inside one of the craft and saw "three things that look like seats," which he describes as amplifiers. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell relays Lazar's words on another episode: "I know there are alien craft here from another planet... I saw other ones, but I was inside one," without mentioning the seats.
